stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: Nothing better than a fast finisher: Jason Thomson banked 168 spots when it counted most.

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Daryl Baldwin of Moore Park GC is welcome back anytime, preferably off a few less shots.

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 4 pars in a row on holes 10-13 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Brilliant and Then Not
stories.detail: nett eagle on hole 1, blow-up on hole 2 - the heart rate approves

stories.title: One Step Forward...
stories.detail: nett birdie on hole 10, bogey on hole 11

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 pars on holes 2, 3 & 4 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: blow-ups, bogeys, pars AND nett birdies - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: blow-ups, bogeys, pars, nett birdies - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Hayden Jeans was 1st at the long break and 10th at the siren, footy can be cruel like that.
